units: Targ. O. Gen. XXXVII, 24; a. e., v. רֵיקָן ch.—Esp. reḳa, an expression of contempt, good for nothing! Taan. 20ᵇ (in Hebr. dict.) ר׳ שמא כל בני עירך וכ׳ Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) reḳa, are all the people of thy town as homely as thou art? Ber. 22ᵃ; a. fr.—Pl. רֵיקַיָּא, רֵקַיָּיא.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:15:1">Koh. R. to IX, 15</cite> <he>ווי ר׳ למחר וכ׳</he> woe to you, worthless men, to morrow the flood shall come &c.
